events.title: Demo Update v0.45.51.109: New Stage Heyang & Saves Carry Over to Full Release
events.summary: Greetings, travelers of Mountains and Seas. Based on feedback from the demo, we have released a new update. Details are as follows: Save Data● Starting with this update, demo save data will carry over to the full release. ● Due to changes to the save system, save data from v0.0.0.76 and earlier cannot be used in this demo version or the full release. New Content ● New Stage: Heyang ● New Boss: Xingtian ● Hidden Boss: Zouwu ● New Weapon: Aquasunder Dual Blades ● Added new Vessels ● New Spirit Bea
